description.zh: 云电脑ID列表。可设置一个或多个，N取值范围：1\~20。
description.en: A list of cloud desktop IDs. You can specify one or more IDs. The number of IDs (N) must be between 1 and 20.

description.en: Region ID. Call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to get a list of regions supported by WUYING Workspace.
